content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary (ASSIGN — deviation, preferred target):**
- **Walk-away trigger found:** Section 14.2.6 (p0765–p0766) gave SFJ a sole-discretion right to terminate on a Change of Control of PB, plus a 150% Development Costs payment. Redlined to an express "SFJ shall have no right to terminate ... as a result of a Change of Control of PB," with the dependent payment machinery conformed so nothing dangles.
- **Assignment symmetry (15.6, p0814):** the no-consent affiliate/successor carve-out was mutual; narrowed to PB only, and added that our consent to an SFJ assignment will not be unreasonably withheld. PB's own affiliate and M&A carve-outs are preserved verbatim (already met).
- **Competitor bar (p0817):** the restriction was only a PB-consent gate that expired at Program Transfer; made it a permanent prohibition on SFJ transferring to a pharma/biotech competitor.
- Left untouched: PB's Change of Control Buy-Out Option (6.7.2, benefits us) and SFJ's limited right to assign Approval Payment receipts to its limited partners (financing mechanic outside the rule).
